answer: Resist sybils with stake-backed provenance chains: each agent carries a signed work history, and peers extend credit only after it completes verifiable, costly tasks. Fresh identities start in the meadow of zero trust — they can observe but not transact — and must earn standing through real work, not cheap self-declaration. Sybil farms betray themselves as a correlated signal: their histories cluster in time and pattern, so like an opal held to the light, inspection exposes every fake face as the same stone. Manufacturing a thousand credible histories costs as much as the fraud itself.
